description: Create or update one outreach template for the authenticated user. Without templateId the template is saved by name (an existing template with the same name is overwritten with the new values instead of duplicated). With templateId the named template is patched, which is the only way to rename it; the fields passed replace the saved ones and omitted fields keep their current value. An overwritten value cannot be recovered. Nothing is sent.

businessContext.description: Company/product context (plain text or markdown) used to ground every generated message.

campaignName.description: Default campaign name suggested when this template is used.

language.description: Language to write in. Defaults to "Português (Brasil)".

name.description: Template name. Required when templateId is omitted.

offering.description: What the sender offers, in the sender's own words. Required when templateId is omitted.

name: save_outreach_template
title: Salvar template de prospecção
